summary: Declared rounding rules (decimals:n, significant:n) rounded half to even, so a display rounded half up (1.03 for 1.025) was reported as a mismatch and the half-even form was accepted.

observables: audit_claims comparison of a display with its source under a declared rounding rule
impact.bias: at an exact tie the expected display was the half-even rounding (1.02 for 1.025), so the half-up display usual in papers (1.03) was flagged and 1.02 passed
impact.trigger: a source value exactly halfway between two displays at the declared precision

remedy: run audit_claims again with a release that has the fix; a record that relied on half-even rounding declares it with ':half-even'
